programmes.programName: Degree of Doctor of Philosophy in Technology Management and Economics
programmes.department: Department of Technology Management and Economics
programmes.evidence: Official doctoral school syllabus explicitly gives English award Degree of Doctor of Philosophy in Technology Management and Economics, departmental host, 240-credit doctorate, doctoral thesis and defense. Current Supply and Operations Management division page explicitly states its participation in PhD education at Technology Management and Economics and describes logistics/freight, manufacturing/service/healthcare operations, SCM planning/control and production-management research.
limitations: SOM is an evidenced research/education area through its doctoral-teaching division; not asserted as a formally named specialization in the doctoral syllabus.

Native award alternatives Teknologie doktorsexamen i Teknikens ekonomi och organisation and Filosofie doktorsexamen i Teknikens ekonomi och organisation are expressly translated by the official syllabus as the same English PhD title; not counted as two doctorates.

programmes.programName: Degree of Doctor of Philosophy in Product and Production Development
programmes.evidence: Current doctoral syllabus names exact English PhD award and Mechanical Engineering host. Subject-description accordion explicitly defines Production Systems as one of three doctoral specializations, covering modelling, simulation, design, operation and maintenance of partially automated production systems. Title-of-degree accordion requires the chosen specialization to appear in degree title.
limitations: One formal specialization of broad Product and Production Development PhD, not a separate broad production degree.
Native Teknologie/Filosofie doktorsexamen alternatives retained as source wording, not duplicate degree awards.
